literal: Family having-been-born, from-fault having-been-freed, blemish shrinking-from sense-of-shame he-who-possesses pointing-indeed trust.
translation: Trust should be placed in a man born of a good family, free from faults, and possessing a sense of shame that shrinks from any blemish.
modern: நல்ல குடியில் பிறந்து, குற்றங்களிலிருந்து நீங்கி, பழிக்கு அஞ்சும் நாணத்தை உடையவனையே தேர்ந்தெடுத்து நம்ப வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet defines the qualities of a person worthy of trust and responsibility. The person must come from a respectable family ('குடி') and be free from flaws ('குற்றத்தின் நீங்கி'). Furthermore, they must possess a deep sense of shame ('நாண்') that makes them shrink from any moral blemish ('வடு'). The word 'சுட்டு' indicates that the choice or direction of one's trust ('தெளிவு') should point exclusively to such an individual.
